title: The future of this channel depends on you.
summary: NH explains that as his family's breadwinner he can no longer spend unpaid hours on YouTube, and that his pride had kept him from asking for help. He opens a voluntary Ko-fi membership page instead of running ads, sponsors, supplements or paid coaching. He sets a two-month goal and promises no perks for donors and no change to the content.
claims: His family now relies on him as sole breadwinner, so he cannot keep putting unpaid time into YouTube
His videos take at least five hours to make, and a tier list about 15 hours
He was raised to see asking for help as weakness, and nearly let the channel die when it was deleted rather than ask for help; he now sees that pride as a weakness to overcome
Walking away from decisions that make you uncomfortable means never growing as a man; be better rather than feel better
If you worry about being a grifter (or a bad parent), that is a sign you are not one
He chose Ko-fi: voluntary, any amount, no platform cut, no censorship, and no preferential treatment for donors
He refuses ads, sponsors, YouTube memberships, supplements and paid coaching; he estimates he has forgone about $50,000 by not monetising
Fitness should be free; the channel's goal is to teach you to coach yourself, so selling expensive coaching would contradict his principles
He spends 20-25 unpaid hours a week on YouTube on top of a 40-hour job; Plan B is a 70-hour work contract
People living paycheck to paycheck should not donate; small monthly pledges are better than one large gift
If the goal fails the channel won't be deleted; he would just upload less often
